dek: Women Photograph, a non-profit launched in 2017 to amplify the voices of women and non-binary visual journalists, has announced three recipients of its 2026 grants. Grants of $10,000 have been awarded to Fatma Fahmy , Caroline Gutman and Yixi Tian . This year’s grants were sponsored by Leica USA Continue reading...
